blocker.detail: The archive does not compile as shipped: gfortran rejects the package routine FREE ('Too many arguments in call to free') because it collides with the C library free. Renaming FREE to FREEBX at two sites fixes it. Compiler-flag routes were tried and ruled out (-fno-builtin, -fno-builtin -fno-builtin-free). The change is a source patch, so the full G2 check stands. Paper check: see reports/kearfott1990-intbis-681/g2-note.md.

attempt: Original authors' archive built as documented: failed, because of the FREE name clash (evidence/original-attempt-build.log). The build compiled the whole text file, prose included, so this is a weak G1 record. Test problem 1 was run on the patched source in two clean passes ('Number of roots found: 3', matching the claim); not counted as a verdict because the patch is not yet G2-cleared.
